text:
Alex Rivera: Quick handoff — I need to swap off ~30m early today, putting Mari on for the rest of the window. Highlights/what changed during my shift:
• Prefetch window increased for embeddings-service (rollout: 3% traffic). Flag: `EMBED_PREFETCH=256` (was 128). Watch for cold-start spike on small instances.
• Canary: quantized Llama2-13B deployed to pool `dedicated-gpu-a` (1 host). Only eval traffic so far.
• Alert tuning: `tok/sec` alert lowered from 1200 -> 1000 for two routes to catch regressions.

Action items for incoming oncall (Mari):
1) Check APM traces for embeddings-service for first 15 minutes after major batches — look for >200ms P99 increase.
2) Monitor canary host CPU/GPU mem; if >85% sustained for 5m, shift traffic back to baseline model.
3) If cold-starts >3% of requests in 10m, roll flag back to 128 and notify infra.

Mari Chen: Ack, on it. I will watch P99 and GPU mem. Will post back in 15m with quick status. :eyes:

Devon Singh: Quick Q — are there any heavy nightly batches still running against `dedicated-gpu-a`? I want to avoid hitting the canary with large evals.

Alex Rivera: Good call — no scheduled batches from my side. Devon, please avoid running bulk eval jobs on `dedicated-gpu-a` until I confirm canary stable (~1h). If you need to run something urgent, target `dedicated-gpu-b`.

Sam Patel: FYI I'll be covering the 23:00 slot. If anything spikes after 22:30 ping me and I can take over. Also suggest adding a quick runbook note under `prefetch-threshold` about today's rollout.

Devon Singh: Copy that, will redirect to `-b` if needed.

Alex Rivera: PR for the prefetch change: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4723 — short diff, can revert with feature flag `EMBED_PREFETCH` to 128. Quick snippet of the flag update:
```
# feature flags
EMBED_PREFETCH=256
```
oncall-bot: Schedule update — Mari Chen set as primary for thread 2245678901 (handoff).

Mari Chen: Quick status at +18m: traces look stable, P99 +30ms on a couple of small routes but within expected. GPU mem on canary host 62%. Continuing to monitor, will update at +40m. :thumbsup:

Alex Rivera: Thanks — leaving notes in the runbook and tagging the PR with `canary-2026-03-18`. If anything looks off, revert the flag first, escalate second.

Mari Chen: Understood. Closing loop in ~40m unless I see anything alarming.

Sam Patel: Thanks team.
